title: DD-suite: A cross-platform package to build Decision Diagrams for optimization purposes
summary: Decision diagrams (DDs) have become a powerful tool for discrete optimization, supporting a wide range of algorithms that span cut-generation procedures, decomposition methods, and specialized branch-and-bound searches. Despite this growth, their adoption remains limited, partly because most existing DD code is tailored to a specific algorithm or application and is therefore hard to reuse. We introduce DD-suite, a cross-platform, open-source software package for building and manipulating DDs for discrete optimization.
